description: This PHP source file defines the DocLexer class, a lexer for parsing docblock annotations, extending AbstractLexer from Doctrine. It includes token definitions, pattern matching, and type determination logic.

classes.name: DocLexer
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractLexer, implementing a lexer for parsing docblock annotations with specific token types and pattern matching.

methods.name: nextTokenIsAdjacent
methods.description: Checks if the next token starts immediately after the current token without non-captured symbols in between.

methods.name: getCatchablePatterns
methods.description: Returns regex patterns for catchable tokens such as identifiers, numbers, and strings.

methods.name: getNonCatchablePatterns
methods.description: Returns regex patterns for non-catchable tokens like whitespace and comments.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the token type based on its value, identifying strings, identifiers, numbers, and specific symbols.
